description: Create a lead. Checks for an existing person FIRST (name, email, phone, social_url) and REFUSES with the candidates if one is found — pass on_duplicate="force" only once you have looked and they really are someone else. A social_url passed here is stored on the lead so the next lookup finds them. 'title' is required. Optional: every column update_lead accepts — status, first/last name, email, best_email, phone, best_phone, address, city, postal_code, country, account_id, contact_id, owner_id, value, notes, next_action(_at), category, website, instagram, fax, source, source_url, extra_1..3, the ad_* origin fields, and the referral_* fields.

ad_click_id.description: The platform's click id (fbclid, gclid, li_fat_id, msclkid, epik, ttclid, oppref).

ad_external_id.description: The platform's own id for this submission. Duplicate guard only.

ad_received_at.description: When the platform recorded the click/submission (ISO).

ad_source.description: Advertising platform the lead came from: meta | linkedin | google_ads | microsoft_ads | pinterest | tiktok | openai_ads.

best_email.description: Preferred e-mail address to reach the lead

best_phone.description: Preferred phone number to reach the lead; used before phone when dialing

custom.description: Lead custom field values { key: value } set in the same call (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'); null clears. Checked like set_custom_values.

next_action.description: Text of the next planned action

on_duplicate.description: 'warn' (default) refuses when an existing person matches and returns the candidates. 'force' creates anyway — use it only after looking at those candidates and concluding this really is someone else.

referral_comment.description: Free-text note on the referral arrangement.

referral_link.description: Link for who/what referred this lead — e.g. a URL, or the in-app link to the referring lead.

referral_share_type.description: 'revenue' or 'profit' — what the agreed share is a percentage of.

social_url.description: Profile URL (LinkedIn etc.). Stored on the lead, so the next duplicate check finds this person by it.

name: create_lead
